picks.why: At 3.4x forward earnings with a 75% operating margin, a 4% FCF yield and revenue +379%, Micron prices in a deep earnings collapse while sitting 44% off its high. It is the cleanest test of the memory-priced-as-peak thesis and fills the watchlist's empty memory slot.
picks.risk: If HBM and DRAM pricing roll over as AI capex slows, earnings could fall faster than the multiple implies, as in past memory busts.

picks.why: TSMC earns a 58% operating margin on +51% revenue at 15.5x forward, 26% off its high after a -12.3% week. Every AI accelerator, from Nvidia's Rubin to Broadcom's ~$115bn AI guide, runs through it, so it is the highest-quality way to own the demand thesis.
picks.risk: A Taiwan or tariff shock, or an AI capex pause, would hit it regardless of quality.
